```{r Initialize working environment}
# Function to silently load packages without warnings or messages
load_packages <- function(pkgs) {
  invisible(lapply(pkgs, function(pkg) {
      suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
          if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
            stop(paste("❌ Package not found:", pkg), call. = FALSE)
          }))
    }))
}

# Vector of required packages

                     "treeio", "scatterpie", "ape", "openxlsx", "tibble",
                     "patchwork", "ape", "ggforce", "stringr", "ggtext", "grid",
                     "svglite")

# Call the function to load them

# Print the information of the working session in order to ensure reproducibility
```

# 2. Individual phylogenetic trees

## 2.1 Extract UFbootstrap support values

```{r Extract UFbootstrap Values from Individual Gene trees (5 genes)}

# Function to extract UFbootstrap values from an IQ-TREE tree file and export
# them as an Excel table compatible with ggtree node-based joins
extract_iqtree_ufboot_to_xlsx <- function(treefile, out_xlsx) {

  # Read the phylogenetic tree generated by IQ-TREE
  tr <- read.tree(treefile)

  # Retrieve the number of terminal taxa and internal nodes
  n_tip  <- length(tr$tip.label)
  n_node <- tr$Nnode

  # Create a node-level table using the same internal node numbering as ggtree
  boot <- tibble(node   = (n_tip + 1):(n_tip + n_node),
                 ufboot = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label)))

  # Export the UFbootstrap table as an Excel file
  write.xlsx(boot, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

  # Report successful file creation
  message("\nExcel created successfully: ", out_xlsx)
}


# Define the set of genes to be processed
genes <- c("actG", "CalM", "ITS", "tefA", "tubB")


# Iterate over each gene and extract its corresponding UFbootstrap values
for (i in seq_along(genes)) {
  gene <- genes[i]
  
  # Select the gene-specific output directory
  out_dir_phy <- paste0("../data/outputs_script_1/", i, "_", gene, "/")

  # Extract UFbootstrap values and save them as a gene-specific Excel file
  extract_iqtree_ufboot_to_xlsx(
    treefile = paste0("../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/MSA_", 
                      gene, "_UFBoot1000.treefile"),
    out_xlsx = paste0(out_dir_phy, "UFBoot_values_", gene, ".xlsx")
  )
}

```

```{r Plot individual gene phylogenetic trees (5 genes)}
# Create function to replace raw tip labels by final labels
clean_tip_label <- function(x) {

  x <- trimws(x)

  if (x %in% names(tip_labels)) {
    return(unname(tip_labels[x]))
  }

  warning("Tip label not found in tip_labels: ", x)

  x
}


# Identify our samples and outgroup to apply format
is_our_sample <- function(x) {
  grepl("^UZ-LAI", x)
}

is_outgroup <- function(x) {
  grepl("^C\\. purpurea\\b", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
}


# Funtion to format host species in parentheses
format_host_name <- function(host) {

  host <- trimws(host)

  # Host with subspecies:
  if (grepl("^[A-Z]\\. [a-z-]+ subsp\\. [a-z-]+$", host)) {

    genus_species <- stringr::str_extract(host, "^[A-Z]\\. [a-z-]+")
    subspecies <- stringr::str_extract(host, "(?<=subsp\\. )[a-z-]+$")

    return(paste0("*", genus_species, "* subsp. *", subspecies, "*"))
  }

  # Standard abbreviated binomial:
  # F. yvesii, F. rothmaleri, C. villosa, etc.
  if (grepl("^[A-Z]\\. [a-z-]+$", host)) {
    return(paste0("*", host, "*"))
  }

  # Full genus/species name if present
  if (grepl("^[A-Z][a-z-]+ [a-z-]+$", host)) {
    return(paste0("*", host, "*"))
  }

  host
}


# Format complete tip labels
format_tip_label <- function(x) {

  # Our samples with identifier in bold; host species in italics
  if (is_our_sample(x)) {

    sample_id <- trimws(sub("\\s*\\([^()]+\\)\\s*$", "", x))
    host <- stringr::str_match(x, "\\(([^()]*)\\)\\s*$")[, 2]

    if (!is.na(host)) {
      return(paste0("**", sample_id, "**", " (**", format_host_name(host), "**)"))
    }

    return(paste0("**", x, "**"))
  }

  # Separate host name from reference label
  host <- stringr::str_match(x, "\\(([^()]*)\\)\\s*$")[, 2]
  main_label <- trimws(sub("\\s*\\([^()]+\\)\\s*$", "", x))
  host_formatted <- if (!is.na(host)) {
    paste0(" (", format_host_name(host), ")")
  } else {
    ""
  }

  # Endophyte subspecies format
  if (grepl("^E\\. typhina subsp\\. [a-z-]+\\b", main_label)) {

    subspecies <- stringr::str_extract(main_label, "(?<=subsp\\. )[a-z-]+")
    prefix <- paste0("E. typhina subsp. ", subspecies)
    rest <- trimws(sub(paste0("^E\\. typhina subsp\\. ", subspecies), "",
                       main_label))
    
    return(paste0("*E. typhina* subsp. *", subspecies, "*",
                  ifelse(rest == "", "", paste0(" ", rest)),
                  host_formatted))
  }

  # Endophyte species
  if (grepl("^E\\. [a-z-]+\\b", main_label)) {

    species <- stringr::str_extract(main_label, "^E\\. [a-z-]+")
    rest <- trimws(sub(paste0("^", gsub("\\.", "\\\\.", species)), "",
                       main_label))

    return(paste0("*", species, "*", ifelse(rest == "", "", paste0(" ", rest)),
                  host_formatted))
  }


  # Outgroup format
  if (grepl("^C\\. purpurea\\b", main_label)) {

    rest <- trimws(sub("^C\\. purpurea", "", main_label))

    return(paste0("*C. purpurea*", ifelse(rest == "", "", paste0(" ", rest)),
                  host_formatted))
  }

  # Others
  paste0(main_label, host_formatted)
}


# Format panel titles
format_panel_title <- function(gene_name) {

  panel <- panel_labels[[gene_name]]

  if (gene_name == "ITS") {
    paste0("**", panel, "**  ITS")
  } else {
    paste0("**", panel, "**  *", gene_name, "*")
  }
}


# Generate final tree
process_tree_final <- function(gene_name, index) {

  # Input and output paths
  treefile_path <- paste0("../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/MSA_", gene_name,
                          "_UFBoot1000.treefile")

  output_dir <- paste0("../data/outputs_script_1/", index, "_", gene_name, "/")

  if (!file.exists(treefile_path)) {
    stop("Tree file not found: ", treefile_path)
  }

  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  # Read tree
  tree <- ape::read.tree(treefile_path)

  # Apply branch-length transformation
  tree$edge.length <- sqrt(sqrt(tree$edge.length))

  # Clean tip labels
  tree$tip.label <- vapply(tree$tip.label, clean_tip_label, character(1))

  # Create base tree
  base_tree <- ggtree::ggtree(tree, linewidth = 0.50)
  tree_data <- base_tree$data


  # Prepare tip labels
  tip_data <- tree_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(isTip) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(display_label = vapply(label, format_tip_label, character(1)),
                  sample_type = dplyr::case_when(vapply(label, is_our_sample, 
                                                        logical(1)) ~ "sample",
                                                 vapply(label, is_outgroup, 
                                                        logical(1)) ~ "outgroup",
                                                 TRUE ~ "reference"))

  # Prepare bootstrap values
  node_data <- tree_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!isTip) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ufboot = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(label))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ufboot), ufboot >= 30)

  # Define plot coordinates for bootstrap
  max_tree_x <- max(tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_y <- max(tree_data$y, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Aligned tip-label position
  label_x <- max_tree_x + max_tree_x * 0.20
  label_line_end <- label_x - max_tree_x * 0.015

  # Fixed bootstrap displacement relative to every node
  bootstrap_x_offset <- max_tree_x * 0.035
  bootstrap_y_offset <- 0.34

  node_data <- node_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(bootstrap_x = dplyr::case_when(
      gene_name == "actG" & node == 54 ~ x + max_tree_x * 0.030,
      gene_name == "CalM" & node == 52 ~ x + max_tree_x * 0.030,
      gene_name == "CalM" & node == 71 ~ x + max_tree_x * 0.030,
      gene_name == "tefA" & node == 64 ~ x + max_tree_x * 0.030,
      gene_name == "tubB" & node == 69 ~ x + max_tree_x * 0.030,
      ufboot == 100 ~ x - max_tree_x * 0.045,
      TRUE ~ x - bootstrap_x_offset),
      
      bootstrap_y = dplyr::case_when(
      gene_name == "actG" & node == 54 ~ y - 0.13,
      gene_name == "CalM" & node == 52 ~ y - 0.35,
      gene_name == "CalM" & node == 71 ~ y - 0.08,
      gene_name == "ITS" & node == 55 ~ y - 0.30,
      gene_name == "tefA" & node == 74 ~ y - 0.35,
      gene_name == "tefA" & node == 61 ~ y - 0.35,
      gene_name == "tefA" & node == 64 ~ y - 0.30,
      gene_name == "tubB" & node == 69 ~ y - 0.05,
      TRUE ~ y + bootstrap_y_offset))

  # Construct final tree
  final_tree <- base_tree +
    geom_segment(data = tip_data, aes(x = x, xend = label_line_end, y = y, yend = y), 
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.40,
                 linetype = "dotted") +

    ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                          dplyr::filter(sample_type == "reference"),
                          aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                          inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.8,
                          fill = NA, label.color = NA,  colour = "black",
                          label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

    ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                          dplyr::filter(sample_type == "sample"),
                          aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                          inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.8,
                          fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                          label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

    ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                          dplyr::filter(sample_type == "outgroup"),
                          aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                          inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.8,
                          fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "grey45",
                          label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

    geom_text(data = node_data, aes(x = bootstrap_x, y = bootstrap_y, label = ufboot),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 3.0, hjust = 0.5, 
              vjust = 0.5) +

    ggtext::geom_richtext(data = data.frame(x = 0, y = max_y + 1.5,
                                            label = format_panel_title(gene_name)),
                          aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                          hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 5.6, fill = NA, 
                          label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                          label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, label_x + max_tree_x * 1.15),
                    ylim = c(0.5, max_y + 2.2), clip = "off") +

    ggtree::theme_tree() +

    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 0, b = 2, l = 0))


  # Display trees 
  print(final_tree)


  # Export files 
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_individual_final.pdf")),
         plot = final_tree,  device = grDevices::pdf, width = 18, height = 24,
         units = "cm", bg = "white")
  ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_individual_final.svg")),
         plot = final_tree, device = "svg", width = 18, height = 24, units = "cm",
         bg = "white")

  invisible(final_tree)
  
}


# Generate all five trees
final_trees <- mapply(FUN = process_tree_final, gene_name = genes,
                      index = seq_along(genes), SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
names(final_trees) <- genes

```



# 3. MSC tree (ASTRAL)

## 3.1 Extract PPs and Qs support values

```{r Extract Qs & PP tables for the MSC tree}

# Set output directory
output_dir <- "../data/outputs_script_1/6_MSCtree/"

# Helper function to parse a node label that contains quartet values (q1, q2, q3)
# and returns a numeric vector c(q1, q2, q3) or c(NA, NA, NA) if it cannot parse.
parse_astral_quartets <- function(lbl) {

  if (is.null(lbl) || is.na(lbl)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_))
  lbl <- as.character(lbl)

  # If there are explicit keys like q1=..., q2=..., q3=...
  has_keys <- grepl("q1\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE) &&
              grepl("q2\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE) &&
              grepl("q3\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)

  if (has_keys) {
    q1 <- sub(".*q1\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    q2 <- sub(".*q2\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    q3 <- sub(".*q3\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    return(as.numeric(c(q1, q2, q3)))
  }

  # If there are three values separated by / , ; | :
  # e.g. "0.2/0.5/0.3" or "0.2,0.5,0.3"
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(lbl, "[/\\|,;:]+"))
  parts <- parts[nchar(parts) > 0]

  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[1:3])))
  }

  # If nothing works
  c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_)
}

# Extract quartet supports from an ASTRAL tree and save to Excel
extract_astral_Q_to_xlsx <- function(treefile, out_xlsx) {

  # Read ASTRAL species tree
  tr <- read.tree(treefile)

  # Node numbering compatible with ggtree
  n_tip  <- length(tr$tip.label)
  n_node <- tr$Nnode
  internal_nodes <- (n_tip + 1):(n_tip + n_node)

  # ASTRAL support is typically stored in tr$node.label
  labels <- tr$node.label

  # Parse q1/q2/q3 for each internal node label
  Qmat <- t(vapply(labels, parse_astral_quartets, numeric(3)))
  colnames(Qmat) <- c("q1", "q2", "q3")

  # Build final table
  Q_df <- tibble(node = internal_nodes,
                 q1 = Qmat[, "q1"],
                 q2 = Qmat[, "q2"],
                 q3 = Qmat[, "q3"])

  # Save to Excel
  write.xlsx(Q_df, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("ASTRAL Q Excel created successfully: ", out_xlsx)

  # Helpful warning if parsing failed
  if (all(is.na(Q_df$q1)) && all(is.na(Q_df$q2)) && all(is.na(Q_df$q3))) {
    message("Warning: q1/q2/q3 are all NA. The quartet values may not be 
            stored in node labels in this treefile.")
  }
}

# Extract quartet supports from the species tree (Qs)
extract_astral_Q_to_xlsx(
  treefile = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_Q",
  out_xlsx = "../data/outputs_script_1/6_MSCtree/Q_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx")


# Helper function to parse a node label containing a posterior probability.
# Accepts formats like "0.98", "pp=0.98", "PP=0.98" and returns numeric or NA.
parse_astral_pp <- function(lbl) {

  if (is.null(lbl) || is.na(lbl)) return(NA_real_)
  lbl <- as.character(lbl)

  # If it contains pp=...
  if (grepl("pp\\s*=", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    val <- sub(".*pp\\s*=\\s*([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", lbl, ignore.case = TRUE)
    return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(val)))
  }

  # Otherwise, try direct numeric conversion
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lbl))
}


# Extract posterior probabilities from an ASTRAL tree and save to Excel. Node 
# numbering matches ggtree: internal nodes = (Ntip+1)..(Ntip+Nnode)

extract_astral_PP_to_xlsx <- function(treefile, out_xlsx) {

  # Read ASTRAL species tree
  tr <- read.tree(treefile)

  # Node numbering compatible with ggtree
  n_tip  <- length(tr$tip.label)
  n_node <- tr$Nnode
  internal_nodes <- (n_tip + 1):(n_tip + n_node)

  # PP usually stored in tr$node.label
  labels <- tr$node.label

  PP_df <- tibble(node = internal_nodes,
                  pp   = vapply(labels, parse_astral_pp, numeric(1)))

  write.xlsx(PP_df, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("ASTRAL PP Excel created successfully: ", out_xlsx)

  if (all(is.na(PP_df$pp))) {
    message("Warning: pp is all NA. The PP values may not be stored in node labels 
            in this treefile.")
  }
}

# Extract posterior probability values from species tree (PP)
extract_astral_PP_to_xlsx(
  treefile = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_PP",
  out_xlsx = "../data/outputs_script_1/6_MSCtree/PP_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx")

```


## 3.2 Format, plot and save MSC tree

```{r Plot and export MSC tree with quartets and PP values}

# Read ASTRAL tree and support value tables
q_tree_path <- "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_Q"
pp_tree_path <- "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ASTRAL_SPTREE_PP"

q_file <- "../data/outputs_script_1/6_MSCtree/Q_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx"
pp_file <- "../data/outputs_script_1/6_MSCtree/PP_values_ASTRAL_SPTREE.xlsx"

if (!file.exists(q_tree_path)) stop("ASTRAL Q tree not found.")
if (!file.exists(pp_tree_path)) stop("ASTRAL PP tree not found.")
if (!file.exists(q_file)) stop("ASTRAL Q support file not found.")
if (!file.exists(pp_file)) stop("ASTRAL PP support file not found.")

tree_Q <- ape::read.tree(q_tree_path)
tree_PP <- ape::read.tree(pp_tree_path)


# Check that both trees have the same dimensions
stopifnot(ape::Ntip(tree_Q) == ape::Ntip(tree_PP),
          tree_Q$Nnode == tree_PP$Nnode)


# Clean tip labels using the same function defined for the individual trees
tree_Q$tip.label <- vapply(tree_Q$tip.label, clean_tip_label, character(1))


# Create base tree
base_astral <- ggtree::ggtree(tree_Q, layout = "rectangular", linewidth = 0.50)

tree_data <- base_astral$data

max_tree_x <- max(tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
max_y <- max(tree_data$y, na.rm = TRUE)
min_tree_x <- min(tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE)


# Prepare tip labels
tip_data <- tree_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTip) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(display_label = vapply(label, format_tip_label, character(1)),
                sample_type = dplyr::case_when(vapply(label, is_our_sample,
                                                      logical(1)) ~ "sample",
                                               vapply(label, is_outgroup,
                                                      logical(1)) ~ "outgroup",
                                               TRUE ~ "reference"))


# Prepare quartet and PP values
q_values <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(q_file) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(node = as.numeric(node), q1 = as.numeric(q1), q2 = as.numeric(q2),
                q3 = as.numeric(q3))
pp_values <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(pp_file) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(node = as.numeric(node), pp = as.numeric(pp))

support_data <- tree_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!isTip) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(q_values, by = "node") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pp_values, by = "node") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(q1) | !is.na(q2) | !is.na(q3) | !is.na(pp))


# Assign manual node numbers
tiff_node_numbers <- tibble::tribble(
  ~node, ~display_node,
     43,  1,
     44,  2,
     45,  3,
     46,  4,
     47,  5,
     48,  6,
     49,  7,
     50,  8,
     51,  9,
     52, 10,
     53, 11,
     54, 12,
     55, 13,
     56, 14,
     57, 15,
     58, 16,
     59, 17,
     60, 18,
     61, 19,
     62, 20,
     63, 21,
     75, 22,
     76, 23,
     77, 24,
     78, 25,
     79, 26,
     64, 27,
     65, 28,
     66, 29,
     67, 30,
     68, 31,
     69, 32,
     70, 33,
     71, 34,
     72, 35,
     73, 36,
     74, 37)

support_data <- support_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tiff_node_numbers, by = "node")



# Format PP values
support_data <- support_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pp_label = dplyr::case_when(is.na(pp) ~ "",
                                            TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", pp)))


# Define plot positions
# Bring tip labels close to terminal branches
label_x <- max_tree_x + max_tree_x * 0.035

# Quartet-pie size
pie_radius <- 0.42

# General PP position relative to each node
pp_x_offset <- -max_tree_x * 0.04
pp_y_offset <- 0.66

# General node-number position relative to each node
node_number_dx <- max_tree_x * 0.031
node_number_dy <- 0.02


# Calculate general PP and node-number positions
support_data <- support_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pp_x = x + pp_x_offset,
                pp_y = dplyr::if_else(display_node %in% c(8, 19),
                                      y - pp_y_offset,
                                      y + pp_y_offset),
                number_x = x + node_number_dx,
                number_y = y + node_number_dy)

# Manual adjustments for node-number positions
node_number_adjustments <- tibble::tribble(
  ~display_node, ~dx, ~dy,
  11, 0.00, -0.1,
  12, 0.00, -0.1,
  14, 0.00, -0.17,
  15, 0.00, -0.1,
  22, 0.00, -0.17,
  23, 0.00, -0.17,
  24, 0.00, -0.17,
  25, 0.00, -0.1,
  32, 0.00, -0.1,
  34, 0.00, -0.17,
  35, 0.00, -0.17,
  36, 0.00, -0.1,)

support_data <- support_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(node_number_adjustments, by = "display_node") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(number_x = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dx),
                                           number_x + dx,
                                           number_x),
                number_y = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dy),
                                           number_y + dy,
                                           number_y)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dx, -dy)


# Optional diagnostic table
pp_node_table <- support_data %>%
  dplyr::select(node, display_node, pp, pp_label, x, y, pp_x, pp_y) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(y))


# Define pie colours
quartet_colours <- c("q1" = "#855885", "q2" = "#F1A340", "q3" = "#F7F7F7")


# Construct final ASTRAL tree
ASTRAL_tree_final <- base_astral +

  scatterpie::geom_scatterpie(data = support_data, aes(x = x, y = y, r = pie_radius),
                              cols = c("q1", "q2", "q3"), colour = "black",
                              linewidth = 0.35, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = quartet_colours, breaks = c("q1", "q2", "q3")) +

  geom_text(data = support_data, aes(x = pp_x, y = pp_y, label = pp_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 3.51, hjust = 0.5,
            vjust = 0.5) +

  geom_text(data = support_data, aes(x = number_x, y = number_y, label = display_node),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey16", size = 2.9, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5) +

  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                        dplyr::filter(sample_type == "reference"),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                        dplyr::filter(sample_type == "sample"),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                        dplyr::filter(sample_type == "outgroup"),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "grey45",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = data.frame(x = min_tree_x - 0.3, y = max_y + 0.20,
                                          label = "**2b**  MSC"),
                        aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                        hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 5.9, fill = NA,
                        label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min_tree_x - max_tree_x * 0.02,
                           label_x + max_tree_x * 0.70),
                  ylim = c(0.5, max_y + 0.65), clip = "off") +

  ggtree::theme_tree() +

  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0))


# Display final tree
print(ASTRAL_tree_final)


# Export ASTRAL tree FINAL TREE
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "ASTRAL_final.pdf"), plot = ASTRAL_tree_final,
       device = grDevices::pdf, width = 21.5, height = 25.5, units = "cm", bg = "white")

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "ASTRAL_final.svg"), plot = ASTRAL_tree_final,
       device = "svg", width = 21.5, height = 25.5, units = "cm", bg = "white")
```

# 4. ML concatenated tree (IQTREE2)

## 4.1 Extract scFL and UFbootstrap support values

```{r Extract SCFL and UFbootstrap values for the ML tree}

# Extract node, sCF (scfl) and Label (ufboot) directly from IQ-TREE cf.stat file
# and save the values into an excel file
extract_scfl_and_ufboot_from_cfstat <- function(cf_stat_file, out_xlsx) {

  # Read cf.stat ignoring comment lines starting with '#'
  stat <- read.delim(cf_stat_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, comment.char = "#",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  # Validate required columns
  required_cols <- c("ID", "sCF", "Label")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(stat))) {
    stop("cf.stat must contain columns: ID, sCF, Label")
  }

  # Select and rename columns to match your plotting pipeline
  out <- stat %>% dplyr::transmute(node = as.numeric(ID) +1,
                                   scfl = as.numeric(sCF),
                                   ufboot = as.numeric(Label))

  # Save Excel
  write.xlsx(out, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

  message("Excel with node, scfl and ufboot created: ", out_xlsx)
}

# Extract the values and save them into an excel file
extract_scfl_and_ufboot_from_cfstat(
  cf_stat_file = "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ML_TREE.cf.stat",
  out_xlsx = "../data/outputs_script_1/7_MLtree/UFBoot_and_scfl_values_MLtree.xlsx")

```


## 4.2 Format, plot and save ML tree

```{r Visualization and export of ML concatenated tree with UFboot and SCFL values}

# Read and prepare ML tree
treefile_path <- "../data/Phylogenetic_analysis/TREES/ML_TREE.treefile"
supportfile_path <- "../data/outputs_script_1/7_MLtree/UFBoot_and_scfl_values_MLtree.xlsx"
output_dir <- "../data/outputs_script_1/7_MLtree/"

if (!file.exists(treefile_path)) {
  stop("Tree file not found: ", treefile_path)
}

if (!file.exists(supportfile_path)) {
  stop("Support file not found: ", supportfile_path)
}

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

treeML <- ape::read.tree(treefile_path)
treeML$edge.length <- sqrt(sqrt(treeML$edge.length))

# Use exactly the same tip-label conversion defined for the individual trees
treeML$tip.label <- vapply(treeML$tip.label, clean_tip_label, character(1))


# Create base tree
base_treeML <- ggtree::ggtree(treeML, layout = "rectangular", linewidth = 0.50)
tree_data <- base_treeML$data


# Prepare tip labels
tip_data <- tree_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTip) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(display_label = vapply(label, format_tip_label, character(1)),
                sample_type = dplyr::case_when(vapply(label, is_our_sample,
                                                      logical(1)) ~ "sample",
                                               vapply(label, is_outgroup,
                                                      logical(1)) ~ "outgroup",
                                               TRUE ~ "reference"))


# Prepare node support values
bootscfl <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(supportfile_path)

bootscfl <- bootscfl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(node = as.numeric(node),
                ufboot = as.numeric(ufboot),
                scfl = as.numeric(scfl))

node_data <- tree_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!isTip) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(bootscfl, by = "node") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ufboot) | !is.na(scfl)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ufboot_label = dplyr::if_else(is.na(ufboot), "NA", sprintf("%.0f", ufboot)),
    scfl_label = dplyr::if_else(is.na(scfl), "NA", sprintf("%.1f", scfl)),
    support_label = paste0(ufboot_label, "/", scfl_label))


# Define general plot coordinates
max_tree_x <- max(tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
max_y <- max(tree_data$y, na.rm = TRUE)
min_tree_x <- min(tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE)

label_x <- max_tree_x + max_tree_x * 0.18
label_line_end <- label_x - max_tree_x * 0.015


# Default default position for all support labels
default_support_dx <- -max_tree_x * 0.008
default_support_dy <- 0.40
default_support_hjust <- 1

# Define manual support-label position adjustments 
# dx: negative = move left and positive = move right
# dy: positive = move up and negative = move down
# Fill table after inspecting the debug tree with node numbers 
support_adjustments <- tibble::tibble(node = numeric(), dx = numeric(),
                                      dy = numeric())

support_adjustments <- tibble::tribble(
  ~node, ~dx, ~dy, ~hjust,
  78, 0.47, 0, 
  75, 0.47, 0, 
  76, 0.47, 0, 
  77, 0.47, 0, 
  74, 0.47, 0, 
  67, 0.42, 0, 
  68, 0.42, -0.55, 
  47, 0.42, 0, 
  48, 0.47, 0, 
  49, 0.47, 0, 
  51, 0.42, -0.4, 
  52, 0.42, -0.4, 
  65, 0.42, 0,
  66, 0.42, 0)

# Calculate final support-label positions
node_data <- node_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("dx", "dy", "hjust",
                                 "dx.x", "dx.y",
                                 "dy.x", "dy.y",
                                 "hjust.x", "hjust.y",
                                 "support_x", "support_y", "support_hjust")))

node_data <- node_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(support_x = x + default_support_dx,
                support_y = y + default_support_dy,
                support_hjust = default_support_hjust) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(support_adjustments, by = "node") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(support_x = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dx), x + dx, support_x),
                support_y = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dy), y + dy, support_y),
                support_hjust = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(hjust), hjust,
                                               support_hjust))


# Define section annotations 
# Retrieve y position of a tip from its final cleaned label
get_tip_y <- function(label_name) {

  result <- tip_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(label == label_name) %>%
    dplyr::pull(y)

  if (length(result) != 1) {
    stop("Tip label not uniquely found: ", label_name)
  }

  result
}


# Define taxonomic sections shown on the right side of the tree
section_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~section, ~top_tip, ~bottom_tip, ~section_colour,

  "<i>Aulaxyper</i><br>(gr. <i>rubra</i>)", "UZ55224 (F. rubra subsp. pruinosa)",
  "UZ44221 (F. nigrescens)", "black",

  "<i>Festuca</i>", "UZ72311 (F. yvesii)",
  "E. festucae Fl1 (F. longifolia)", "black",

  "<i>Aulaxyper</i>", "UZ11238 (F. rothmaleri)",
  "UZ9234 (F. rothmaleri)", "black",

  "<i>Lojaconoa</i>", "UZ-LAI_1.24(9) - F. triflora",
  "UZ-LAI_1.24(8) - F. triflora", "white",

  "<i>Festuca</i> *", "E. festucae FG1 (F. glauca)", 
  "E. festucae FG1 (F. glauca)", "black",
  
  "<i>Schedonorus</i>", "E. festucae AL9436 (F. pratensis)",
  "E. festucae AL9436 (F. pratensis)", "white")

section_data <- section_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_top_raw = get_tip_y(top_tip),
                y_bottom_raw = get_tip_y(bottom_tip),
                y_top = ifelse(top_tip == bottom_tip, y_top_raw + 0.40,
                               y_top_raw + 0.35),
                y_bottom = ifelse(top_tip == bottom_tip, y_bottom_raw - 0.40,
                                  y_bottom_raw - 0.35),
                y_mid = mean(c(y_top, y_bottom))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

section_bar_x <- label_x + max_tree_x * 0.55
section_text_x <- section_bar_x + max_tree_x * 0.03
section_bar_width <- max_tree_x * 0.015


# Define higher-level FL and BL annotations
major_section_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~major_section, ~top_tip, ~bottom_tip, ~major_colour,
  
  "**FL**", "UZ55224 (F. rubra subsp. pruinosa)", "UZ9234 (F. rothmaleri)",
  "black",
  
  "**BL**", "UZ-LAI_1.24(9) - F. triflora", "E. festucae AL9436 (F. pratensis)",
  "white")

major_section_data <- major_section_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_top_raw = get_tip_y(top_tip),
                y_bottom_raw = get_tip_y(bottom_tip),
                y_top = y_top_raw + 0.35,
                y_bottom = y_bottom_raw - 0.35,
                y_mid = mean(c(y_top, y_bottom))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

major_section_bar_x <- section_text_x + max_tree_x * 0.30
major_section_text_x <- major_section_bar_x + max_tree_x * 0.03
major_section_bar_width <- max_tree_x * 0.02


# Position of tip labels
label_x <- max_tree_x + max_tree_x * 0.026


# Construct final ML tree
ML_tree_final <- base_treeML +
  geom_segment(data = tip_data,
               aes(x = x, xend = label_x, y = y, yend = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey14", linewidth = 0.40,
               linetype = "dotted") +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                          dplyr::filter(sample_type == "reference"),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                          dplyr::filter(sample_type == "sample"),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = tip_data %>%
                          dplyr::filter(sample_type == "outgroup"),
                        aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = display_label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "grey45",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +
  geom_text(data = node_data,
            aes(x = support_x, y = support_y, label = support_label,
                hjust = support_hjust),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 3.51, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = section_data, aes(xmin = section_bar_x - section_bar_width / 2,
            xmax = section_bar_x + section_bar_width / 2, ymin = y_bottom,
            ymax = y_top, fill = section_colour), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = section_data,
                        aes(x = section_text_x, y = y_mid, label = section),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.2,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +
  geom_rect(data = major_section_data,
            aes(xmin = major_section_bar_x - major_section_bar_width / 2,
                xmax = major_section_bar_x + major_section_bar_width / 2,
                ymin = y_bottom, ymax = y_top, fill = major_colour),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

  scale_colour_identity() +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = major_section_data,
                        aes(x = major_section_text_x, y = y_mid,
                            label = major_section),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
                        size = 4.3, fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                        colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = data.frame(x = min_tree_x,
                                          y = max_y + 0.35,
                                          label = "**2a**  ML"),
                        aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 5.9,
                        fill = NA, label.color = NA, colour = "black",
                        label.padding = grid::unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min_tree_x - max_tree_x * 0.008, 
                           major_section_text_x + max_tree_x * 0.12),
                  ylim = c(0, max_y + 0.5),
                  clip = "off") +

  ggtree::theme_tree() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0))



# Display final tree
print(ML_tree_final)


# Export final ML tree
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "MLtree_final.pdf"),
       plot = ML_tree_final, device = grDevices::pdf,
       width = 22.8, height = 25.5, units = "cm", bg = "white")

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "MLtree_final.svg"),
       plot = ML_tree_final, device = "svg",
       width = 22.8, height = 25.5, units = "cm", bg = "white")
```
